name: Octree Raycasting
definition: An algorithm to find all octants in a pointer-based octree that intersect with a given ray, returning them sorted by distance (closest first). It uses parametric ray representation (t-values) to traverse the octree structure efficiently.
summary: Octree Raycasting is an algorithm that efficiently finds and sorts all octants intersecting a ray by explicitly computing and sorting parametric t-value intervals.
